description: Multi-threaded JavaScript UI runtime and self-evolving Agent OS where components, state, and VDOM run inside an Application Worker.
rules: End every Neo class definition with Neo.setupClass(MyClass); never call super() or initialize reactive configs inside constructor().
Define reactive configs inside static config = { myProp_: defaultValue } with a trailing underscore and implement beforeGetMyProp, beforeSetMyProp, and afterSetMyProp hooks.
Batch multiple reactive config updates using instance.set({ propA: 1, propB: 2 }) so the VDOM engine coalesces changes into a single delta.
Components, state.Provider, and data.Store run inside the Application Worker; never access window, document, or raw DOM nodes directly in component code.
Use DomEvents or Neo.main.addon.* RPC bridges when main-thread browser APIs or DOM measurements are required.
Bind data-driven UI components to a Neo.data.Store of Neo.data.Model records or a view-root Neo.state.Provider rather than hand-mapping raw arrays.
